newsitem.title: UK: BTR falls further after press comment.
newsitem.headline: BTR falls further after press comment.

text.p: Shares in BTR Plc fell for the fourth straight session on Tuesday amid continued selling pressure as a press comment underscored concerns about the company's dividend policy, dealers said.
By 1157 GMT, the shares were down 4p to 182-1/2p on trading volume of 9.5 million shares. They were the third most actively traded shares in London.
The Financial Times noted fears that BTR may not be able to cover this year's dividend because of cash flow problems.
"The dividend has always been a concern," said one market maker. "There are just no buyers.
